# Lead Machine Learning Scientist, Search

Cardiff, London or Remote (UK)

***🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.***

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

---

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰 £115,000 - £150,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits  ✨

## **About our Machine Learning Search Team**

We are currently embarking on one of our two top strategic priorities to make Money work for Everyone: building the Monzo Co-pilot. We are becoming an intelligent, proactive ally that handles the complexity of users financial life. We aren't just selling financial products; we are building a truly smart agent that understands users, anticipates their needs, and helps people reach their financial goals.

Our ML Search team brings together Backend, Product, Machine Learning Scientists and Data Scientists. As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you’ll build and ship models that help customers search for and find answers about their financial lives. You'll make it effortless for them to find the right products at the exact moment they need them.

Whether it’s surfacing the right savings product at the perfect moment, helping customers manage their spending, or simplifying financial planning, our work makes banking smarter, more intuitive, and truly customer-first.

## **What you’ll be working on:**

As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you'll be a technical leader and individual contributor. We have a modern, cloud-native data platform with billions of rows of data built for fast iterations. You'll leverage your deep expertise to develop and deploy advanced ML models to our more than 15 million customers.

Your work may involve user and product embeddings to better understand customer behaviours, contextual bandits for optimising real-time decisions, or personalised ranking algorithms that improve search and discovery. You'll also build scalable, explainable, and responsible AI solutions that enhance trust, transparency, and the overall customer experience.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. For everyone, everywhere.

More about our mission.

  

Job Description

  

The team is building a robust control framework to ensure the entire Wise product portfolio is covered with essential screening checks and prevent onboarding of sanctioned individuals,  organisations and politically exposed people. We ensure that associated risks are thoroughly mitigated and that controls are functioning effectively.

We are scaling our operations team and developing robust solutions to ensure that screening alerts are accurately checked, fully auditable and seamlessly managed. As part of this effort, we are also focused on enhancing the customer experience, making it easier and more convenient for customers impacted by sanctions to provide necessary information and documents, while ensuring clear communication throughout the process.

In this role, you will work closely with our operational back-office and compliance teams to understand their workflows and challenges. You’ll take a leading role in redesigning and rebuilding our internal tooling solutions for case handling and management, creating tools that are intuitive, efficient and scalable. By improving both internal tools and customer-facing processes, you’ll make a significant impact on our operational excellence and the overall experience for our customers.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

* You build and maintain our design system in React and Tailwind, so features stay consistent instead of being rebuilt from scratch each time.
* You own frontend performance in Next.js 16 — rendering strategy, bundle size, and what people actually experience on a mediocre connection.
* You treat accessibility as a default, not as cleanup at the end of the sprint.
* You develop the Node.js layer (Express.js, Nest.js) between the UI and our backend services, with Redis where caching helps.
* You push for clean code and automated testing, and you share what you know instead of sitting on it.
* You use coding agents as part of your daily workflow — directing their work, reviewing their output, and fixing what doesn't hold up. Writing code matters; knowing what good code looks like matters more.

## Your profile

* You've spent several years building production frontends with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
* You know Tailwind CSS well and you've managed client-side state with Zustand.
* You test what you build — unit and component tests with Vitest, end-to-end tests with Playwright.
* You're comfortable in Node.js with Express.js or Nest.js, and working against APIs from a microservices backend.
* You work well in agile teams (Scrum/Kanban), you write clearly, and you're comfortable in English.
* You have a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or the experience that makes one unnecessary.

## Nice to have

* You've worked with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. We're not in the cloud yet, so this is a plus, not a requirement.

## How you think

We care as much about how you approach a problem as about which frameworks you know. You look past the edges of your own ticket: you notice when a fix really belongs in a different service, you question a process once it has stopped making sense, and you judge your work by whether the whole system got better — not by whether your part shipped. "Not my code" isn't a sentence we use much around here.

## Why us?

You're joining at a point where the engineering foundations themselves are being rebuilt around AI-native workflows — not retrofitted onto legacy decisions, but designed now, while the architecture is still being shaped. That means you don't inherit someone else's five-year-old choices: you help make the calls on how services are split, where AI agents fit into the workflow, and what "good" looks like technically around here.
